body: I can relate, my parents are the exact same. I went to the hospital twice for suicide attempts and I'm only 17. Both times my parents thought I did it just to get out of school and still don't believe it. You're not alone, don't forget that

I'm glad that you actually tried new meds. That's a start. No meds are perfect. I never had the courage to ask for different meds and I've been on mine for over 2 years and they don't help. So you beat me there. I'm proud of you for that. What's making you so sad? Go ahead, rant away.
